text:
Situation: Palonosetron 0.05 mg/mL 5 mL single-dose vials have 84 units on hand at Corvale East, covering 18.7 days at the current 4.5 vials per day usage rate. Teva Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. posted a discontinuation of its palonosetron hydrochloride injection on 2025-11-14. FDA's drug shortage list does not include palonosetron as of 2026-10-21.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list shows palonosetron is not listed as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Supply is adequate for the near term. Multiple manufacturers not on the FDA shortage list are available for purchase. No clinical changes are proposed; any therapeutic alternatives remain the decision of treating clinicians and the committee.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Apotex Corp. as the primary replenishment source; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Avyxa Pharma, LLC as a secondary source; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
3. Buyer to qualify BluePoint Laboratories as a tertiary source; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
4. Buyer to monitor Baxter Healthcare Corporation availability as an additional option; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
5. Buyer to track daily usage and update days-on-hand weekly; requires Pharmacy Manager approval.

Not recommended: No allocation, rationing, or therapeutic substitution at this time.
